name: H1-PA: the PCA-aligned redesign of H1, three arms
supersedes: H1 for promotion only: logs/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/plans/h1_annulment.json; H1's evidence is kept and is not part of this study
status: DESIGN, NOT FROZEN. D4-Reasoning's training schedule is unresolved: at E1's batch size and 3 epochs it trains 660 optimizer steps against the other arms' 2,916 (audit/h1pa_audit.json :: schedule). Choosing a schedule is the maintainer's; no formal training until it is chosen and this file is frozen

questions.Q1: Under identical data and training conditions, is the D4 initialization better than PCA? (Comparison A: D4-Original - PCA-Original)
questions.Q2: With D4 fixed and the training method and compute budget controlled, does the 70/30 reasoning data help unseen-problem reasoning correctness more than the original training data? (Comparison B: D4-Reasoning - D4-Original)
questions.C: PCA-Original against D4-Reasoning, end to end; descriptive, changes initialization and data together, attributes to neither

PCA-Original.execution: reuse the trained checkpoints; re-evaluate only

20260801._durability: the only copy is on the dev box (the relay refused it for quota in 2026-08); it goes to the study's durable storage before any session reads it

d4_top1.tokenizer: the PCA init directory's tokenizer (the record's tokenizer_binding): the files E1 loaded

e1_2p96M._pack: E1's own pack: E1 trained from artifacts/stage3/ladder_uniform, whose blocks/ladder/audit hashes E1's run manifests record and these files carry

reasoning_v3_seq._source: the sessions the @v3 pack was built from, re-derived from the P1 and P1t stores (h1pa_audit sessions); no teacher generation
reasoning_v3_seq.builder: scripts/shared/data/build_token_ladder.py (E1's sequential packer, unchanged; it rebuilds E1's pack byte for byte)

20260801.recorded_in: configs/stages/stage-3/e6b/provenance.json :: e6b_p2_r2960k_sb.rung_parent_sha256 (E1 sb's run manifest was not preserved)

recipe.derive: a D4 run's config is its seed's E1 config with student_path (the D4 directory), tokenizer_source (the PCA init directory E1 loaded its tokenizer from), data_dir (the arm's pack), run_name, out_dir and _purpose replaced; every other key, nested keys included, unchanged
recipe.facts: batch size 2 sequences (blocks_per_step), micro-batch size 1 (micro_blocks), gradient accumulation steps 2, sequence length 8,192 (block_len), 3 epochs, 2,916 optimizer steps on E1's pack, 146 warmup steps, AdamW lr 5e-5 betas (0.9, 0.95) eps 1e-8 weight decay 0.01, gradient clipping 1.0, cosine to 0.1 of peak, CE 0.25 + KD 1.0 (T 1, KD over every non-padding position), fp32 weights with bf16 autocast, gradient checkpointing, teacher Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507@768f209d9ea81521153ed38c47d515654e938aea in bf16, validation 16 sequences past the largest rung

evaluation.set: eval-set-1 (its registered identity, validity mask and scoring semantics unchanged)
evaluation.every_checkpoint: two PCA-Original, two D4-Original and two D4-Reasoning checkpoints, each generated once under the same protocol and seed rule

hardware.why: E1 trained this exact configuration on L40S with a 39.96 GB logged peak (sa train_log.jsonl :: gpu_mem_gb)
hardware.datacenters_with_l40s_and_volumes: chosen at launch from a live query (2026-10-24: EU-NL-1, EUR-IS-2, US-MO-1, stock Low in each)
